scripts.source:
function onTouched(hit)
	if hit.Parent:findFirstChild("Humanoid") ~= nil and hit.Parent:findFirstChild("Chest") == nil then
		local g = script.Parent.Parent.Chest:clone()
		g.Parent = hit.Parent
		local C = g:GetChildren()
		for i=1, #C do
			if C[i]:IsA("BasePart") then
				local W = Instance.new("Weld")
				W.Part0 = g.Middle
				W.Part1 = C[i]
				local CJ = CFrame.new(g.Middle.Position)
				local C0 = g.Middle.CFrame:inverse()*CJ
				local C1 = C[i].CFrame:inverse()*CJ
				W.C0 = C0
				W.C1 = C1
				W.Parent = g.Middle
			end
				local Y = Instance.new("Weld")
				Y.Part0 = hit.Parent.Torso
				Y.Part1 = g.Middle
				Y.C0 = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0)
				Y.Parent = Y.Part0
		end

		local h = g:GetChildren()
		for i = 1, # h do
			h[i].Anchored = false
			h[i].CanCollide = false
		end
	end
end

script.Parent.Touched:connect(onTouched)

scripts.source:
script.Parent.Name = "Waiting..."
repeat wait() until game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character
wait(2.5) 
script.Parent.Name = "Nightfury 75"
local power = 75
bin = script.Parent 
bpos = Instance.new("BodyPosition") 
gyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro") 
gyro.maxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge,math.huge,math.huge) 
bpos.maxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge,math.huge,math.huge) 
fly = false 
player = game.Players.LocalPlayer 
char = player.Character.Torso 
airborne = false 

function onButton1Down(mouse) 
fly = true 
while fly do 
pos = mouse.Hit.p
cpos = char.CFrame.p
unt = (pos-cpos).Unit

--gyro.cframe = CFrame.new(char.Position,pos) 
bpos.position = char.Position + (pos-char.Position).unit * power
wait() 
end 
end 

function Calc(mouse)
	local VSX,X = mouse.ViewSizeX,mouse.X
	local VSX2 = (VSX/2)
	local Ratio = ((VSX2 - X)/VSX2)
	Ratio = (Ratio < -1 and -1 or Ratio > 1 and 1 or Ratio)
	return math.rad(Ratio * 90)
end

function onMove(mouse) 
pos = mouse.Hit.p 
gyro.cframe = CFrame.new(char.Position,pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, Calc(mouse))
end 

function onButton1Up(mouse) 
fly = false 
end 

function onSelected(mouse) 
print("select") 
if mouse == nil then 
return 
end
oldC = workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraType
workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraType = "Follow"
airborne = true 
bpos.Parent = char 
bpos.position = char.Position + Vector3.new(0,2,0) 
gyro.Parent = char 
char.Parent.Humanoid.Sit = true 
mouse.Button1Down:connect(function() onButton1Down(mouse) end) 
mouse.Button1Up:connect(function() onButton1Up(mouse) end) 
mouse.Move:connect(function() onMove(mouse) end) 

for i, v in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do 
if v.className == "Motor" then 
v.MaxVelocity = 0 
v.CurrentAngle = -1 
if v.Name == "Left Hip" then 
v.CurrentAngle = 1 
end 
end 
end 
end 

function onDeselected(mouse) 
workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraType = oldC or "Classic"
print("deselect") 
gyro.Parent = nil 
fly = false 
airborne = false 
for i, v in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do 
if v.className == "Motor" then 
v.MaxVelocity = 1 
end 
end 
char.Parent.Humanoid.Sit = false 

if not airborne then 
bpos.Parent = nil 
end 
end 


bin.Selected:connect(onSelected) 
bin.Deselected:connect(onDeselected)

scripts.source:
function onTouched(hit)
	if hit.Parent:findFirstChild("Humanoid") ~= nil and hit.Parent:findFirstChild("Chest") == nil then
		local g = script.Parent.Parent.Chest:clone()
		g.Parent = hit.Parent
		local C = g:GetChildren()
		for i=1, #C do
			if C[i]:IsA("BasePart") then
				local W = Instance.new("Weld")
				W.Part0 = g.Middle
				W.Part1 = C[i]
				local CJ = CFrame.new(g.Middle.Position)
				local C0 = g.Middle.CFrame:inverse()*CJ
				local C1 = C[i].CFrame:inverse()*CJ
				W.C0 = C0
				W.C1 = C1
				W.Parent = g.Middle
			end
				local Y = Instance.new("Weld")
				Y.Part0 = hit.Parent.Torso
				Y.Part1 = g.Middle
				Y.C0 = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0)
				Y.Parent = Y.Part0
		end

		local h = g:GetChildren()
		for i = 1, # h do
			h[i].Anchored = false
			h[i].CanCollide = false
		end
	end
end

script.Parent.Touched:connect(onTouched)

script.Parent.Name = "Waiting..."
repeat wait() until game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character
wait(2.5) 
script.Parent.Name = "Nightfury 75"
local power = 75
bin = script.Parent 
bpos = Instance.new("BodyPosition") 
gyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro") 
gyro.maxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge,math.huge,math.huge) 
bpos.maxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge,math.huge,math.huge) 
fly = false 
player = game.Players.LocalPlayer 
char = player.Character.Torso 
airborne = false 

function onButton1Down(mouse) 
fly = true 
while fly do 
pos = mouse.Hit.p
cpos = char.CFrame.p
unt = (pos-cpos).Unit

--gyro.cframe = CFrame.new(char.Position,pos) 
bpos.position = char.Position + (pos-char.Position).unit * power
wait() 
end 
end 

function Calc(mouse)
	local VSX,X = mouse.ViewSizeX,mouse.X
	local VSX2 = (VSX/2)
	local Ratio = ((VSX2 - X)/VSX2)
	Ratio = (Ratio < -1 and -1 or Ratio > 1 and 1 or Ratio)
	return math.rad(Ratio * 90)
end

function onMove(mouse) 
pos = mouse.Hit.p 
gyro.cframe = CFrame.new(char.Position,pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, Calc(mouse))
end 

function onButton1Up(mouse) 
fly = false 
end 

function onSelected(mouse) 
print("select") 
if mouse == nil then 
return 
end
oldC = workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraType
workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraType = "Follow"
airborne = true 
bpos.Parent = char 
bpos.position = char.Position + Vector3.new(0,2,0) 
gyro.Parent = char 
char.Parent.Humanoid.Sit = true 
mouse.Button1Down:connect(function() onButton1Down(mouse) end) 
mouse.Button1Up:connect(function() onButton1Up(mouse) end) 
mouse.Move:connect(function() onMove(mouse) end) 

for i, v in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do 
if v.className == "Motor" then 
v.MaxVelocity = 0 
v.CurrentAngle = -1 
if v.Name == "Left Hip" then 
v.CurrentAngle = 1 
end 
end 
end 
end 

function onDeselected(mouse) 
workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraType = oldC or "Classic"
print("deselect") 
gyro.Parent = nil 
fly = false 
airborne = false 
for i, v in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do 
if v.className == "Motor" then 
v.MaxVelocity = 1 
end 
end 
char.Parent.Humanoid.Sit = false 

if not airborne then 
bpos.Parent = nil 
end 
end 


bin.Selected:connect(onSelected) 
bin.Deselected:connect(onDeselected)

	orb.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 2)
	orb.Transparency = 0.3
	orb.BrickColor = BrickColor.Blue()

	fire.SecondaryColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	local upForce = Instance.new("BodyForce", orb)

	orb.CFrame = CFrame.new(origin, endp)
	orb.Velocity = orb.CFrame.lookVector*100
	orb.CanCollide = false
	orb.Parent = workspace

		end

	end)

	       --make and do a hit test along the ray
